text:
2010 FIFA World Cup, nke e mere na South Africa site na 11 June ruo 11 July, bụ mbipụta mbụ nke asọmpi a mere na kọntinent Africa. Ndị otu iri atọ na abụọ sonyere, kewara n’ime otu asatọ nke anọ; ndị abụọ kacha elu n’otu ọ bụla gara n’akụkụ knockout nke otu onye na-apụ nke gụnyere round nke 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals, egwuregwu maka ọnọdụ nke atọ na nke ikpeazụ.

Agba otu wetara ọgba aghara n’oge. Mba nnabata South Africa ghọrọ mba nnabata mbụ a chụpụrụ n’agba otu, ebe ndị ruru ikpeazụ nke 2006, Italy na France, pụtakwa tupu agba knockout. Ka ndị otu na-ebelata, Uruguay pụtara dị ka ike na-atụ anya, rute semi-finals ma mechaa bụrụ nke anọ, ebe Diego Forlán na-eduzi ọsọ ha.

Ikpeazụ, nke e mere na Soccer City dị na Johannesburg, tinyere Spain na Netherlands. N’egwuregwu siri ike na-enweghị goolu nke gbatịrị ruo oge mgbakwunye, Andrés Iniesta doziri egwuregwu ahụ na nkeji 116, na-emechi mmeri 1–0. Nsonaazụ ahụ nyere Spain aha mmeri World Cup mbụ ya ma mee ka ọ bụrụ mba Europe mbụ meriri asọmpi ahụ na mpụga Europe. Germany wepụtara ọnọdụ nke atọ.

Nsọpụrụ onye ọ bụla kesara n’etiti ndị otu ndị isi. Thomas Müller nke Germany meriri Golden Boot mgbe ndị egwuregwu anọ mechara otu ọkwa na goolu ise—Müller, David Villa nke Spain, Wesley Sneijder nke Netherlands na Forlán nke Uruguay—e nyekwara Müller ihe nrite ahụ n’ihi na o nyere assists atọ. Forlán nwetara Golden Ball dị ka onye egwuregwu kacha mma n’asọmpi ahụ, ebe Iker Casillas nke Spain nwetara Golden Glove dị ka onye nche mgbaru ụzọ kacha mma.

Asọmpi ahụ dọtara ngụkọta ndị na-ele anya 3,178,856 n’ime egwuregwu 64 ya, na-enweta ihe dị ka 49,670 kwa egwuregwu. Na mgbakwunye na iko ahụ n’onwe ya, 2010 bụ nke e ji kọwaa site na ihe mbụ ya: World Cup na ala Africa, onye mmeri Europe e chiri okpueze na mpụga Europe, mba nnabata a chụpụrụ n’agba mbụ, na aha mmeri ụwa mbụ maka Spain.
